ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels account for approximately 90% of the fluke area. High-intensity (white) pixels are localized to distal tip clusters and scattered surface abrasions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary. other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced secondary notch on the right lobe trailing edge which provides a highly unique geometric signature.
